AllowDestTableNotEmpty.description_en:
The policy for handling records that exist in the destination table object. Valid values: Ignore and Stop Migration.

If you set this parameter to true, which means Ignore: When data exists in the destination table object, if the original data conflicts with the data to be written, Data Transmission Service logs the conflicting data and keeps the original data unchanged.


<notice>

  If you select Ignore, full verification pulls data in IN mode. In this case, scenarios with multiple data entries in the destination cannot be verified, and verification performance is degraded.

</notice>
If you set this parameter to false, which means Stop Migration: When data exists in the destination table object, an error is reported and the full migration is not allowed. You must handle the data in the destination table before you continue the migration.


<notice>

  If you click Resume after an error occurs, Data Transmission Service ignores this configuration and continues to migrate the table data. Proceed with caution.

</notice>
AllowDestTableNotEmpty.description_zh:
目标端表对象存在记录时处理策略，包括 忽略 和 停止迁移。
设置为 true，表示选择忽略：当目标端表对象存在数据时，如果原数据与写入数据冲突，数据传输采用将冲突数据记录日志，保留原数据不变的策略进行数据写入。
<notice>选择忽略，全量校验将使用 IN 模式拉取数据，无法校验目标端多数据的场景，并且校验性能存在一定程度降级。></notice>
设置为 false，表示选择停止迁移：当目标端表对象存在数据时，全量迁移会报错不允许迁移，请处理好目标端数据后再继续迁移。
<notice>如果出错后单击恢复，数据传输将忽略该配置选项，继续迁移表数据，请谨慎操作。></notice>
AllowDestTableNotEmpty.title_zh: 允许目标端表非空，在源端多个分表向目标端一张表聚合迁移时，需要打开
